about: Read by both key guards' tests: the Linux supervisor's (apps/bridge/test/supervisor/usage-limit.test.ts) and the Mac's (Tests/TalosDesktopCoreTests/KeyGuardTests.swift). captures: every real capture under Fixtures/real-*, and the intents a key may be sent with on it (each side checks the ones it has: Linux has theme and security_notes, the Mac has computer_use). usage_limit: the synthetic usage-limit screens, each with the model and the reset both readers must give. not_usage_limit: screens neither may read as it. Reviewed by hand, 2026-11-13. Every pattern is a whole-string match (Swift wholeMatch, TypeScript ^…$), digits written [0-9] (never \d, which is Unicode in ICU).

status_row_vectors.about: Rows drawn under Claude's empty input box ('⏺ Done.', a rule, '❯ ', a rule, then these rows) and whether the empty-box key goes (box_empty). Positive-shape spec (after Fable R3): only a mode head seen in the captures (manual mode, plan mode, accept edits, auto mode, bypass permissions, each optionally with '(shift+tab to cycle)' or its cut '(shift+tab') or Talos's current row opens parts Talos does not know: each ASCII [a-z0-9 /+.:,-], 1 to 24 characters, not a single word of 4 letters or fewer, not starting with an option number (digits then . or )), no "y/n"; at most 2 per row and 1 such row; the old recorder row opens none, and its model must start with Opus, Sonnet, Haiku, Fable or Claude then a space or its end; a row with a control, format or replacement character is refused whole.
